description: This PHP source file defines the CountryDao class, which is responsible for data access operations related to country and province entities in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve lists of countries and provinces, as well as fetch specific country or province records by various identifiers.

classes.name: CountryDao
classes.description: Data access object for handling country and province data operations in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves an ordered list of all countries.

methods.name: getProvinceList
methods.description: Fetches a list of provinces, optionally filtered by a given country code.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Fetches a country entity by its name.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Fetches a country entity by its country code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Retrieves a province entity based on its province code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceName
methods.description: Retrieves a province entity based on its name.
